cues: Cardiac muscle beats by itself: it is myogenic.
The pacemaker is the sino atrial node in the wall of the right atrium, firing about seventy two times a minute.
The wave spreads over the atria, pauses about a tenth of a second at the atrioventricular node, then races down the bundle of His and the Purkinje fibres into the ventricles.
